0xebd03b35: The object of MONOPOLY is to be the wealthiest player at the end of the game. You earn wealth by buying, trading, and improving properties in order to charge rent to the other players.||Each player in the game takes turns rolling the dice and moving around the game board. If you roll the same number on both dice, you earn doubles and get to take another turn! If a player lands on an un-owned property, they can purchase it for themselves or put it up for auction, where all players can bid for it. When a player buys a property, it becomes theirs, and any other player that lands on it must pay rent to the owner.||If a player owns all properties in a single color group, they can build houses and hotels on it to increase the amount of rent other players need to pay. Building improvements is the best way to drive other players into debt and increase your own personal wealth.||If a player ever needs extra cash, they can sell improvements or mortgage properties, but if another player lands on a mortgaged property, they will not be charged rent. Players can un-mortgage properties by paying back the original mortgage amount to the bank, plus 10% interest.||If any player ever owes more money than they can pay back, even after selling their improvements and mortgaging their properties, they must declare bankruptcy and retire from the game.||

0xcd47b26f: Here are some tips and tricks to help you become a better MONOPOLY player!||Basic Tips||Rolling the same number on both dice is called "rolling doubles". This lets you take an extra turn! Statistically, players will land on Orange properties more than any other color group.||The Red property set is the second-best to own, and statistically, Trafalgar Square is the most landed-on individual property in the entire game.||Railroads are always a good investment.
